svg.title: South Fraser Health Region — horizontal colour logo with Healthy Individuals / Healthy Communities (vector reconstruction)
svg.desc: Reconstruction of the July 2001 horizontal colour lockup. Symbol, lettering, rule and tagline are the original vector outlines from the April–May 2001 South Fraser Health Region newsletter (PDF page 1), repositioned unchanged to the horizontal arrangement of the 2001 raster. Colours are approximations averaged from that dithered raster.
